'''Ganga sap''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]]-derived substance found on the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon of Endor]]. The sap was extremely sticky.<ref name="TTOL">{{Ewoks|The Tree of Light}}.</ref> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> the [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Umwak]] made a trap that consisted of a [[Net/Legends|net]] soaked in ganga sap. Although he and [[Umwak's nephew|his nephew]] attempted to use the net to trap some [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] in the [[Arbo Maze]], the Duloks became entangled in their own trap during the ensuing [[Skirmish in the Arbo Maze|skirmish]].<ref name="TTOL" />
